title: Production LLM Engineering
goal: Build, evaluate, optimize and ship reliable LLM systems.

excellence.name: Independent build
excellence.description: Ship an end-to-end LLM system on an unfamiliar dataset without tutorial-driven implementation.

excellence.name: Evaluation
excellence.description: Separate retrieval, generation and system-level failure modes with held-out tests.

excellence.name: Transfer
excellence.description: Solve novel architecture and debugging problems without pattern matching to a known solution.

competencies.name: Foundations
competencies.description: Probability, linear algebra, optimization and neural-network basics that everything else rests on.

competencies.name: Transformers
competencies.description: Attention, positional encoding, MHA/MQA/GQA and why the architecture behaves as it does.

competencies.name: Embeddings
competencies.description: How embedding models represent meaning, similarity metrics, and their failure modes.

competencies.name: Retrieval & RAG
competencies.description: Chunking, indexing, hybrid search, reranking and getting evidence into context.

competencies.name: LLM Evaluation
competencies.description: Separating retrieval, generation and system failures with held-out, measurable tests.

competencies.name: Inference & Optimization
competencies.description: KV cache, batching, quantization, speculative decoding and memory/latency trade-offs.

competencies.name: Agents & Tool Use
competencies.description: Tool use, planning loops, and making agent behaviour observable and testable.

competencies.name: Production Systems
competencies.description: Deploying, observing and operating LLM systems under cost, latency and reliability constraints.
